bah.coverageNote: DoD BAH for 338 MHAs. ZIP→MHA crosswalk not supplied — provide --zip-mha for nationwide ZIP lookup.

basePay.coverageNote: DFAS 2026 basic pay — all grades E-1–E-9, W-1–W-5, O-1–O-10. Senior-grade caps may apply at very high years of service.

cola.conusColaNote: CONUS COLA applies in select high-cost U.S. areas; look up via DTMO.
cola.oconusColaNote: Overseas COLA varies by location and exchange rate; look up via DTMO.
cola.ohaNote: OHA replaces BAH overseas and is reimbursement-based; look up via DTMO.
